title: Experience
subtitle: Ten years across AI engineering, embedded systems, and industrial automation.

items.title: AI Engineer
items.description: Led an 8-person backend team delivering enterprise Java features on a high-stakes client engagement, earning a contract renewal. Transitioned to spearhead Globant Italy's AI engineering practice: architecting and building production LLM applications — multi-agent orchestration pipelines, RAG systems with graph-based retrieval (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, pgvector), and generative AI–powered process automation — deployed on AWS and GCP. Primary technical authority on AI integration for the Italian operation.

items.title: Senior Software Designer
items.description: Owned the full development stack for seismic and structural health monitoring systems — from bare-metal C/C++ firmware on microcontrollers (power management, GPS sync, ADC pipelines) to Python signal-processing tooling built on ObsPy. Led a 4-person engineering team on Progetto Atlante, an EU-funded research initiative (POR FESR 2014-2020, Tuscany Region) in partnership with CNR-INO and the University of Florence, delivering a remote structural vibration monitoring prototype with sub-micrometric sensitivity via infrared digital holography.

items.title: Lead Software Engineer
items.description: Sole software engineer on the Soft FX Skin Analyzer — an ARM-based touchscreen diagnostic device now commercially sold to professional aesthetic clinics worldwide. Took full ownership of the application layer: C++/Qt/QML UI, real-time image acquisition and processing pipelines with OpenCV and GStreamer (100× and 400× magnification probes), wireless connectivity stack (WiFi, Bluetooth, Ethernet), and report generation. Built a custom Yocto Linux distribution tailored to the product's footprint and security requirements. Rapid-prototyped device enclosures via 3D printing to accelerate hardware iteration cycles.

items.title: Software / Automation Engineer
items.description: Developed and modified PLC software (Siemens, Allen-Bradley), adapted HMI operator interfaces and integrated Fanuc robotic systems (Fanuc-certified) — from electrical schematic review through on-site integration and acceptance testing. Took direct field responsibility for system commissioning at customer sites. Developed internal web tooling that reduced manual project tracking overhead across the engineering team.

items.title: Web Developer
items.description: Built a home-automation product end to end while studying: Java EE/Tomcat backend, PHP modules, and a jQuery frontend that made a PLC-based home system configurable by non-technical end users. Contributed backend (Java) and frontend (JavaScript) development to a web-based workplace safety management platform, integrating against SQL Server, PostgreSQL, and Oracle DB.
